selected_upstream.selection_evidence: Independently observed by git ls-remote, an exact-tag clone, git rev-parse of the selected commit and tree, and local file inspection in the research clone.
selected_upstream.tag_movement_policy: The tag is only a selection label. The commit and tree are the immutable evidence identity; any future tag resolution mismatch fails B0.

license.required_follow_up: Generate and independently review SBOM and license report for BMF, bundled/configured FFmpeg codecs, and every transitive build/runtime dependency.

dependency_resolution.poc_policy: Require an isolated provider root and fail if linkage resolves to ambient host /usr or ambient host shared libraries.
dependency_resolution.additional_mutability: build.sh downloads a breakpad release asset when absent.

frozen_provider_runtime_policy.preferred_distribution: immutable digest-pinned provider-local multi-stage OCI image
required_lock_manifest_fields: FFmpeg 4.4 source checksum for initial compatibility
every codec/dependency commit or tarball checksum
CPU architecture or GPU runtime/device ABI compatibility
frozen_provider_runtime_policy.cpu_image: Minimum dependency closure for the one deterministic Gaussian blur path; exclude GPU and unrelated modules.
frozen_provider_runtime_policy.gpu_image: CPU contract plus pinned CUDA runtime/toolkit compatibility, CV-CUDA/blur_gpu closure, driver/device ABI requirements, and device probe evidence.

runtime_fingerprint_contract.definition: ProviderImplementation runtime fingerprint is the deterministic normalized digest over the OCI image digest, lock-manifest digest, enabled-module set, dynamic-linkage inventory digest, and normalized probe output; GPU additionally includes normalized device/runtime/driver ABI evidence. It is runtime compatibility/provenance, never a canonical media-semantic digest.

common: image digest and lock-manifest digest match
BMF import/load and selected commit/version evidence
enabled module inventory includes the chosen blur path and excludes undeclared modules
dynamic libraries resolve only inside the provider image/root
CPU architecture and required instruction-set compatibility
probe freshness and deterministic normalized output digest
gpu_additional: driver version and supported CUDA runtime ABI
VRAM/capacity observation supplied to H1-owned runtime/resource authority
required_probe_evidence.failure_policy: Missing, stale, unknown, mismatched, ambiently linked, or unreviewed evidence is typed incompatibility and fails closed.

h1_boundary.h2_owns: ProviderImplementation dependency declaration, private probe implementation, runtime fingerprint construction, and provider-specific incompatibility diagnostics.
h1_boundary.h1_owns: Shared WorkerRuntime, host/device identity and incarnation, resource/capacity/availability, placement, reservation, and hardware/runtime authority.
h1_boundary.forbidden: H2 must not introduce competing canonical WorkerRuntime, GPU, device, driver, capacity, or placement models.

required_proof: clean network-controlled build from the complete lock manifest
minimum blur path loads and executes in isolation
normalized probe/runtime fingerprint matches WorkerRuntime evidence
b0_go_precondition.decision: B0 success is a GO precondition; this document does not claim BMF builds, runs, or conforms.
